product.olivetti-m30.summary: The compact Linea 1 system could serve the M20.
product.olivetti-m30.history: Olivetti announced Linea 1 in 1982. The M30 covered business and technical or scientific work. The M34 retained its case and MOS compatibility.
product.olivetti-m30.architecture: MOS supported custom applications. Olivetti documented a BASIC environment shared by the M30 and M40.
product.olivetti-m30.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m30.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
